claims: The 2026 Men's NCAA Final Four will be held at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, Indiana.
Games of the 2026 Men's NCAA Final Four will occur on April 4 and April 6, 2026.
Lucas Oil Stadium is a regular host for the Men's NCAA Final Four tournament.
Lucas Oil Stadium will feature the national semifinals and championship game of the 2026 Men's NCAA Final Four.
The dates of the 2026 Men's NCAA Final Four are April 4–6, 2026.
The host of the 2026 Men's NCAA Final Four is Horizon League and IU Indianapolis.
The 2026 Women's Final Four will be held in Phoenix, Arizona.
